title: Word Index (flatMap)
hints: IntStream.range(0, lines.size()) gives the line indexes; each line becomes many (word, line number) pairs with flatMap.
Split a line into words with Arrays.stream(line.toLowerCase().split("[^a-z]+")).filter(w -> !w.isEmpty()).
Collect with groupingBy(Entry::word, TreeMap::new, mapping(Entry::line, toCollection(TreeSet::new))): sorted words, sorted line numbers without repeats.

pt-br.title: Índice de palavras (flatMap)
hints: IntStream.range(0, lines.size()) dá os índices das linhas; cada linha vira vários pares (palavra, número da linha) com flatMap.
Divida uma linha em palavras com Arrays.stream(line.toLowerCase().split("[^a-z]+")).filter(w -> !w.isEmpty()).
Colete com groupingBy(Entry::word, TreeMap::new, mapping(Entry::line, toCollection(TreeSet::new))): palavras ordenadas e números de linha ordenados, sem repetir.
